mapper.select:
SELECT B.ID, B.TITLE, B.WRITER, B.REG_DATE, COALESCE(C.CNT, 0) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM BOARD B LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BOARD_ID, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM BOARD_COMMENT GROUP BY BOARD_ID ) C ON C.BOARD_ID = B.ID
ORDER BY B.ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (ID, TITLE, WRITER, CONTENT, DEL_YN, REG_DATE) VALUES (BOARD_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{title}, #{writer}, #{content}, 'N', SYSTIMESTAMP)
